title: Field Notes 001
subtitle: Seven small doors into ordinary life
author: The Static Collective

encounters.title: The Door That Didn't Open
encounters.text: Something refuses to happen today. Do not rush to name the refusal. A closed door is first a fact; meaning can wait.
encounters.carry: What appears empty may merely be unoccupied.

doors.title: PASS DIFFERENTLY
doors.prompt: Take a route you normally ignore. Notice one thing you would not have seen otherwise.

doors.title: ASK ONCE
doors.prompt: Ask one honest question you have been postponing. Do not force an answer.

doors.title: LEAVE SPACE
doors.prompt: Cancel one unnecessary act of filling. Keep ten minutes deliberately unoccupied.

encounters.title: A Small Thing Has Followed You
encounters.text: Look for the ordinary object, phrase, sound, or color that has appeared more than once lately. Repetition is not proof. It is permission to notice.
encounters.carry: Attention can hold a thing without explaining it.

doors.title: PHOTOGRAPH IT
doors.prompt: Record one recurring ordinary thing exactly as it appears.

doors.title: NAME THE ECHO
doors.prompt: Write down the repeated word, object, color, or sound. Nothing more.

doors.title: GIVE IT AWAY
doors.prompt: Tell someone else one small thing you noticed today and let their response remain theirs.

encounters.title: The Map Has a Blank Place
encounters.text: There is somewhere nearby you have never entered, even though your life repeatedly passes its edge. Today the edge is enough to begin.

doors.title: CROSS A THRESHOLD
doors.prompt: Enter one public place you normally pass by. Stay long enough to notice its texture.

doors.title: WALK TO THE EDGE
doors.prompt: Go to the boundary of a familiar route and look past it.

doors.title: ASK FOR A NAME
doors.prompt: Learn the name of one place, plant, street, object, or person you usually leave unnamed.

encounters.title: Borrowed Weather
encounters.text: Not every mood in a room began inside you. Notice what you are carrying, and what may have arrived from somewhere else.
encounters.carry: You may witness weather without becoming weather.

doors.title: STEP OUTSIDE
doors.prompt: Change rooms or go outdoors for five minutes before deciding what you feel.

doors.title: RETURN A BURDEN
doors.prompt: Write one responsibility that is actually yours and one that is not.

doors.title: BRING CALM
doors.prompt: Do one small thing that lowers friction for another person without announcing it.

encounters.title: Inventory of Enough
encounters.text: Before seeking another tool, answer, purchase, or permission, examine what is already within reach.
encounters.carry: Provision often enters the story before the need has a name.

doors.title: EMPTY YOUR POCKETS
doors.prompt: Make a literal inventory of what you are carrying right now.

doors.title: USE THE OLD TOOL
doors.prompt: Finish one small task using something you already own.

doors.title: SHARE SURPLUS
doors.prompt: Give, lend, or offer one useful thing that is sitting idle.

encounters.title: The Unfinished Conversation
encounters.text: Some conversations remain alive because they were interrupted rather than completed. You do not have to resolve one today. You can simply locate it.
encounters.carry: Unfinished is a condition, not a verdict.

doors.title: WRITE THE NEXT LINE
doors.prompt: Privately write the next honest sentence in an unfinished conversation.

doors.title: SEND A GENTLE PING
doors.prompt: Where appropriate and safe, send a simple message that asks for nothing except contact.

doors.title: LET IT REST
doors.prompt: Choose not to reopen one conversation today. Record why rest is the better crossing.

encounters.title: The Week Leaves a Trace
encounters.text: Before beginning something new, look backward without trying to make a lesson. What remains after the week is evidence of where attention actually went.
encounters.carry: A trace is smaller than a theory and often more useful.

doors.title: READ YOUR RECEIPTS
doors.prompt: Review the notes you kept this week. Circle one repeated word.

doors.title: KEEP ONE OBJECT
doors.prompt: Choose one physical or digital object from the week and preserve it deliberately.

doors.title: CLOSE ONE LOOP
doors.prompt: Finish one task that has remained open for at least three days.
